connection_condition: schools.District names the district that operates the school; district and school codes share the CDSCode prefix
description: A district is composed of the schools it operates; a school record has no meaning without its district.

connection_condition: free meal count divided by enrollment for the same age scope
description: The eligible free rate is computed as the free or reduced price meal count divided by enrollment, per school and per age scope.

connection_condition: NumGE1500 divided by NumTstTakr for the same school
description: The excellence rate is computed as the count of test takers scoring 1500 or above divided by the total test taker count.

connection_condition: administrator names and e-mails are stored on the school row rather than in a separate person table
description: Administrators manage the school; the connection is an attribute of the school record, not a separate entity relationship.
A set is composed of its card printings; a printing cannot exist without the set it belongs to.
Foreign-language printings are language-specific variants of a card and cannot exist without the base card printing.
Localized set names are parts of the set record, one per language.

connection_condition: both name the same set, one in English and one in a target language
description: A set can be identified by its English name or by any localized translation of that name; both express the same business concept.
Rulings belong to a card printing and are meaningless without it.

connection_condition: legalities holds one status row per card and format
description: Legality status is only meaningful relative to a play format; the pair together answers whether a card may be played somewhere.
Monthly consumption records are parts of a customer's consumption history and cannot exist without the customer.

connection_condition: transactions_1k.GasStationID identifies the station where the transaction took place
description: Transactions occur at a gas station and are attributed to it.
A product is purchased in a transaction, but product records exist independently of any single transaction.

connection_condition: customers.Segment holds the segment label on the customer row
description: Each customer belongs to one business segment that shapes how consumption is compared.

connection_condition: yearly totals of the same segment and currency in consecutive years
description: Consumption change and percentage increase are derived from yearly aggregates of monthly consumption.
A district is composed of the clients who live there; a client record requires a district.
Loans are granted to an account and cannot exist without it.
Transactions are movements on an account and have no meaning without that account.

connection_condition: disp.client_id and disp.account_id connect clients to accounts; one client may hold several accounts
description: Clients own or use accounts through the disposition link, so the connection is many-to-many rather than a simple containment.
Statement issuance frequency describes how an account is serviced and is chosen per account.
A race is composed of the classified results of its drivers; a result cannot exist without a race.
A circuit hosts races; a race is held at exactly one circuit and cannot exist without it.
A driver full name is derived by combining forename and surname; natural-language questions name drivers this way.

connection_condition: minimum lap time per driver per race; results.rank orders those minima
description: The fastest lap is the minimum lap time recorded in a race, ranked within the race.

connection_condition: a populated results.time marks a finished race
description: Race completion is derived from whether a result carries a race time, and the completion rate aggregates that flag.
Driver age and birth year are derived from the date of birth and drive oldest and youngest comparisons.

connection_condition: drivers.nationality is a text label with no country reference table
description: Nationality is associated with a driver as a free-text attribute rather than a foreign key to a country entity.
A member full name is derived by combining first name and last name.
An event is composed of its budget lines; a budget line cannot exist without its event.
Attendance records are parts of an event and are meaningless without it.
Individual expenses are charged against a budget line and cannot exist without it.
An expense is attributable to the member who spent the money.
Income receipts are recorded against the member who received the funds.
A major groups the members who study it; a member record carries exactly one major.

connection_condition: major.department and major.college hold the owning unit
description: A major is part of an academic department within a college.

connection_condition: income.source holds the source label on the income row
description: The income source classifies why funds were received, but has no independent entity record.
A publisher is composed of the superheroes it publishes; a hero requires a publisher record.
Attribute measurements are parts of a hero profile and cannot exist without the hero.

connection_condition: hero_power.hero_id and hero_power.power_id link heroes to powers
description: A hero is characterised by assigned superpowers drawn from the shared power catalogue.

connection_condition: eye_colour_id and hair_colour_id both reference colour.id
description: Eye colour and hair colour are different attributes expressed over the same colour value domain, so a colour label means the same thing in both.

connection_condition: hair_colour_id and skin_colour_id both reference colour.id
description: Hair colour and skin colour share the colour reference list and therefore the same label semantics.
Gender classifies a hero through a small reference list including an N/A label.
Laboratory records are parts of a patient's history and cannot exist without the patient.
Examination records belong to a patient and are meaningless without one.

connection_condition: current year minus year of Birthday
description: Patient age is derived from the birth date and the current date.

connection_condition: thresholds are stated per analyte in the workload evidence
description: A normal range classifies analyte measurements without being stored as a column; the interpretation is applied by the analyst.

connection_condition: KCT, RVVT and LAC are columns on the examination row
description: Coagulation measures are recorded as part of a clinical examination.

connection_condition: every carcinogenic molecule id exists in molecule
description: A carcinogenic molecule is a kind of molecule: its value domain is the subset of molecules labelled carcinogenic.

connection_condition: every non-carcinogenic molecule id exists in molecule
description: A non-carcinogenic molecule is a kind of molecule: its value domain is the subset of molecules labelled non-carcinogenic.
A molecule is composed of its atoms; an atom cannot exist without its molecule.
A molecule is composed of its bonds; a bond cannot exist without its molecule.
A bond realises the connection between its two atoms and gives the connection its type.

connection_condition: count of atoms of an element divided by the total atom count of the molecule
description: The element ratio is derived from the element composition of a molecule's atoms.
